results.title: Neeraj Chopra to Clash With CWG Gold Medalist Rumesh Pathirage In Star-Studded Lausanne Diamond League Field
results.description: Rumesh Pathirage clinched the gold medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow with a massive second-round throw of 89.75m, securing Sri Lanka's first-ever athletics gold. Neeraj Chopra briefly claimed the top spot with a season-best effort of 85.83m on his second attempt, ultimately settling for the silver medal
